title: Emerald / architectural relief
positive: A wide architectural bas-relief of Ma Durga carved into emerald green malachite and ivory marble, photographed as a luxury modern museum installation. The beautiful peaceful goddess appears as a small full-crowned face and sari-covered shoulder relief in the center, occupying only one third of the width. No visible arms. Large symmetrical art-deco stepped arches radiate outward across the panorama, alternating deeply recessed black-green stone and thin champagne-brass edges. A finely carved lion HEAD medallion is built into each far side of the architecture, clearly decorative reliefs rather than living animals. The face is smooth pale marble, with carefully inlaid black eyes and a tiny vertical forehead eye. Soft raking light reveals physical depth, restrained materials, powerful broad geometry, intricate center and calm outer edges. A respectful contemporary artistic interpretation of Ma Durga, serene, beautiful and powerful. Two carefully matched natural almond eyes with aligned pupils, plus one small distinct vertical third eye centered on the forehead. Fully clothed. Panoramic 104:45 composition, a clear face readable on an LED wall, generous breathing room. No lettering.
